# Debugging Record

## Issue ID
DEBUG-XXX

## Date
YYYY-MM-DD

## Related Requirement / Test
REQ-XXX / TEST-XXX

## Problem Description
Describe the problem or unexpected behavior.

## Expected Behavior
Describe what the system should have done.

## Actual Behavior
Describe what the system actually did.

## Observed Evidence
Record the evidence collected during investigation.

Examples:
- Terminal output
- Compiler errors
- Debugger observations
- Register values
- UART logs
- Screenshots
- Measurements
- Error messages

## Initial Hypothesis
Describe the suspected cause before investigation.

## Investigation
Document the steps performed to investigate the problem.

1. Step one
2. Step two
3. Step three

## Root Cause
Document the confirmed technical cause of the problem.

## Corrective Action
Describe the change made to fix the root cause.

## Verification
Describe how the fix was tested.

## Verification Result
Describe the result after applying the fix.

## Final Status
OPEN / INVESTIGATING / FIXED / VERIFIED

## Lessons Learned
Document what was learned and what could prevent the same issue in the future.
